claims.title: Ideal auxiliary chain
claims.english_claim: The feasible ideal auxiliary chain satisfies variance at most 80000 d^17 times energy.
hypotheses: Equal-total natural margins; finite index sets; d=10+(m+1)(n+1).
limitations: Ideal completion transitions; a step count does not give machine runtime.
